blueprint.name: IBM ROKs Foundation
blueprint.description: Provisions IBM Cloud ROKs cluster and attached Transit Gateway

outcomes: An IBM ROKS cluster is provisioned
A COS instance for the cluster registry is created from the cluster name
A transit gateway is created from the cluster name
Cluster outputs are available for managed-cluster registration in BNK

prerequisites.description: The modules/cluster deployment pack from this repository must already be synced into Forge.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: Provide an IBM Cloud credential template or project secret that can supply the IBM Cloud API key.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Operators provide the cluster name, worker sizing, region, and IBM Cloud credentials. Registry COS and transit gateway names are derived automatically from the cluster name.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key for cluster provisioning.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region for the ROKS cluster.

required.name: roks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the IBM ROKS cluster to create.

required.name: workers_per_zone
required.description: Number of worker nodes per zone.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used by the deployment.

optional.name: min_worker_memory_gb
optional.description: Minimum worker node memory in GB.

modules.name: ROKS Cluster
modules.description: Provision the IBM ROKS cluster, registry COS instance, and transit gateway.
